result:

Summary of work:
- `app/components/Home.vue` — title, subtitle, `Health`/`Transcribe` buttons navigating via `$navigateTo`
- `app/components/Health.vue` — placeholder with exact spec labels (`Health access: not requested`, buttons, `Last 7 Days`, `No data yet`)
- `app/components/Transcribe.vue` — placeholder with exact spec labels (`Speech access: not requested`, buttons, `No transcript yet`)
- Back navigation relies on the automatic iOS nav-bar back button (no extra code needed since iOS is the only target)

`ns build ios` succeeds, and the app runs and navigates correctly on the iOS Simulator with no crashes.
